intro: Dust Devil Debris consists of the swirling grit and elemental remnants left behind by the aggressive air spirits wandering Westfall. Mages value these charged particles as magical reagents, using their airy essence to enchant parchment and bind messaging spells into scrolls.

p: The dry plains of Westfall have become increasingly agitated, plagued by violent whirlwinds known as Dust Devils. When struck down, these living storms collapse into a heap of charged dust and grit known as Dust Devil Debris. Rather than being mere dirt, the residue retains a faint trace of the elemental vortex that gave it life. Arcane practitioners like Collin Mauren in Stormwind prize such material for specialized sorcery. By infusing the grit into enchanted ink and parchment, a wizard can bind an airy messaging spell onto a scroll, enabling distant communication across the kingdom.
